quote: Sometimes you walk through life carrying heavy grief, pretending that you are doing fine. You hide your quiet tears from everyone passing by. You build thick walls to protect your gentle heart. But loneliness still creeps into your quiet empty rooms. What you truly crave is someone to hold you close. Let your armor fall down so love can finally enter.
